title: 第1750章 魔狱第1749章 巴奥
content_zh:
第1750章魔狱
“小杂碎，我要你死，我—定要你后悔来到这个世上！”
望着出现在视线内的玉龙战车，巴奥的眼中也是陡然涌上暴虐杀意，身体表面，都是有着血光涌起。
“传令，放弃战场一切，全力歼灭那辆战车。”
“大人，如此安排，会不会……”
那蓝服指挥以为巴奥只顾私仇，连忙劝道。
“你懂什么，战车上那个小子年龄境界俱是甚低，全靠战车加持，一旦为我所获，不但此处尽数剿灭，就连无涯子，也休想活命！”
巴奥的眼神，变得极为森冷起来，他寒声道：“速速传令，照我说话去做！”
私仇固然是有，但战场大局观仍旧没有丢失，这就是巴奥的厉害之处。
“是！”
其身旁，黄袍指挥应道，而后快速执行。
“什么人敢冲击我方阵地，找死！”
此时，天空炸响，破空声响起，有不少魔族强者御空而行，追击而来。
显然，战场上的魔族强者已经察觉到了玉龙战车的存在，此时，他们距离玉龙战车，越来越近。
而且，这辆战车也无视他们的警告，继续气势汹汹的冲来。
“死！”
此时，一个魔族统领，已经逼近玉龙战车了，悍然出手。
这个魔族统领，身上的气息浑厚无比，赫然是大藏境六重的强者，虽然及不上奎瓦，但却要比先前那魔族统领强上不少。
他脸色森冷，战枪挥出，就是数十道璀璨的枪影狂掠而出。
完全将玉龙战车笼罩。

咻！咻！
其后方，一道道攻势紧随而来，磅礴魔气层层涌动，无数恐怖的攻击铺天盖地的席卷而下。
每一道攻击，都蕴含着令人不能忽视的力量，顿时，令到这片虚空，布满了不堪负苛的空间裂纹。
命令虽然没有正式传到，但魔族的凝聚力，却是由此而略见一斑。
“这倒是有点意思了！”
虚空中，石总指挥目睹着这—幕，他舔了舔嘴唇，喃喃自语。
要说先前，他或许还会担心，但自从见到肖恩斩杀奎瓦统领，这种担心，早已化为信心。
他巴不得肖恩能够吸引更多的攻击，为战场尽可能的减轻压力。
当然，最终的目的，还是尽快开启终极模式。
而肖恩，却不清楚什么终极模式，不过，他的心显得要比石总指挥还急，因为他还要赶到高端战场。
所以，面对着这铺天盖地而来的攻势，他眼神一厉，直接是卷起无尽玄气洪流，手中雷魔斧一斧劈出。
轰！
伴随着一声震耳欲聋的滚雷炸响。
一道粗大的紫色雷电从雷魔斧处凭空出现，如同一道紫色雷光，直接射向穿了那些魔族强者密集之处，炸裂开来。
轰隆隆！
漆黑的斧光，凌厉异常，透出无尽的紫色雷霆，向那些魔族强者密集之处的中心吞噬而去。
紫光四散，那耀眼的光芒，仿佛天地日月也将因它而黯然失色。
嗖！
肖恩身子一动，消失在原地，而后出现在那些魔族强者密集之处的中心，一斧横扫。
在紫雷之下，大片热血从斧刃接触处中喷射而出，喷湿了肖恩的脸庞。

但，肖恩没有在意。
他身形一动，身体快速在那些魔族强者中游动，不过数秒，数十个魔族强者全部被划破了喉咙，成为了一具尸体。
肖恩的双手，沾满了他们的鲜血。
然而，这些鲜血，以及那一道道生命的消失，依旧不能掩盖他惊天的杀意。

Chapter 1750 Demon Prison
"Little bastard, I want you to die, I will make you regret coming to this world!"
Looking at the Jade Dragon Chariot that appeared in his sight, Bao's eyes suddenly filled with violent murderous intent, and there was blood all over the surface of his body.
"Send the order, abandon everything on the battlefield, and use all your strength to annihilate that chariot."
"Sir, will this arrangement mean that..."
The blue-suited commander thought that Bao was only interested in personal hatred, so he quickly advised him.
"What do you know? The kid on the chariot is very young. He relies on the blessing of the chariot. Once he is captured by me, not only will everyone here be wiped out, but even Wu Yazi will not be able to survive!"
Bao's eyes became extremely cold, and he said in a cold voice: "Send the order quickly and do as I say!"
Although there are personal vendettas, the overall view of the battlefield has not been lost. This is the power of Bao.
"Yes!"
Beside him, the yellow-robed commander responded and then quickly executed.
"Whoever dares to attack our position is seeking death!"
At this time, there was an explosion in the sky and the sound of breaking through the air. Many strong demons were flying in the air and chasing after them.
Obviously, the strong demons on the battlefield have noticed the existence of the Jade Dragon Chariot. At this time, they are getting closer and closer to the Jade Dragon Chariot.
Moreover, the chariot ignored their warnings and continued to charge menacingly.
"Death!"
At this time, a demon leader had already approached the Jade Dragon Chariot and took action boldly.
The aura of this demon leader was extremely strong, and he was clearly a strong man at the sixth level of the Great Tibet Realm. Although he was not as good as Kuiwa, he was much stronger than the previous demon commander.
His face was cold, and he swung his war gun, and dozens of bright gun shadows rushed out.
Completely shrouding the Jade Dragon Chariot.
call out! call out!
Behind it, one attack after another followed closely, majestic demonic energy surged layer by layer, and countless terrifying attacks swept down overwhelmingly.
Every attack contained a power that could not be ignored. Suddenly, the void was filled with unbearable space cracks.
Although the order was not officially transmitted, the cohesion of the demon clan was slightly revealed from this.
"This is quite interesting!"
In the void, Commander Shi witnessed this scene, he licked his lips and murmured to himself.
Before, he might have been worried, but since he saw Sean kill Commander Kueva, this worry has already turned into confidence.
He wished that Sean could attract more attacks and reduce the pressure on the battlefield as much as possible.
Of course, the ultimate goal is to activate the ultimate mode as soon as possible.
As for Sean, he didn't know what the ultimate mode was, but he seemed to be more anxious than Commander Shi because he still had to rush to the high-end battlefield.
Therefore, facing this overwhelming offensive, he glared sharply, directly rolled up the endless torrent of profound energy, and struck out with the thunder demon ax in his hand.
boom!
It was accompanied by a deafening roar of rolling thunder.
A thick purple thunder and lightning appeared out of thin air from the Thunder Demon Axe, like a purple thunder light, it shot directly through the dense concentration of those powerful demons and exploded.
Boom!
The dark ax light was extremely sharp, revealing endless purple thunder, swallowing towards the center of the densely populated area of ​​those powerful demons.
The purple light scattered in all directions, and the dazzling light seemed as if the heaven, earth, sun and moon would be eclipsed by it.
Whoosh!
Sean moved, disappeared on the spot, and then appeared in the center of the gathering place where the powerful demons were gathered, and swept across with an axe.
Under the purple thunder, a large amount of hot blood spurted out from the contact point of the ax blade, wetting Sean's face.
However, Sean didn't care.
He moved and swam quickly among the powerful demons. Within a few seconds, all the dozens of powerful demons had their throats slashed and turned into corpses.
Sean's hands were covered in their blood.
However, the blood and the disappearance of the lives could not conceal his terrifying murderous intention.
